subject: Renewal: Private deployment capacity increase & isolation for Q3
messages:
From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@medicorps.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Medicorps Contracts <contracts@medicorps.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal: Private deployment capacity increase & isolation for Q3

Karthik,

Hope you had a good weekend. We're reviewing our Redwood Private renewal (current term ends 2027-06-30) and have a couple of new requirements for Q3: a) spin up two additional isolated clusters in our EU region for a new analytics tenant, and b) increase reserved capacity on our existing on-prem enclave by ~30% to handle a new ETL pipeline.

High level asks:
- Can you provide a SOW addendum outlining the scope and timelines for the two isolated clusters?
- Estimated one-time provisioning costs and delta to our monthly reserved pricing (we're prepared to discuss a 12–24 month term).
- Any SLA exceptions we should plan for during the cutover window and recommended fallbacks.

I've attached a short summary of our current deployment and expected peak qps (current-deployment-summary.pdf). Would like to get procurement kicked off in the next two weeks to hit a July 1 target if feasible.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Johnson
Head of Platform Engineering
Medicorps

Attachment: current-deployment-summary.pdf (PDF, 430KB)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@medicorps.com>, Medicorps Contracts <contracts@medicorps.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal: Private deployment capacity increase & isolation for Q3

Alex — thanks for the clear ask and the attachment. High level: this is doable and we should plan for a staged rollout to avoid disruption to your analytics pipeline.

Next steps I propose:
1) Internal scoping & SOW draft (we'll include provisioning steps, IP/ASN, and timeline options).
2) Pricing delta + term options (12-month and 24-month commit models).
3) Cutover runbook + fallback (we'll call out temporary cross-region routing and cache priming).

Priyom / Marissa — can you take the lead on architecture + commercial? I want a draft SOW and a pricing delta by EOD Wednesday so we can share with Alex and Contracts.

Alex — we'll include a proposed maintenance window (low-traffic hours) and a plan to keep at least one existing cluster in-place during cutover. If you have a preferred blackout window in July, share that and we'll target it.

I'll attach our proposed architecture diff and a first-pass amendment in follow-up.

Karthik
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: proposed-architecture-diff.png, redwood-amendment-draft-v2.docx
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal: Private deployment capacity increase & isolation for Q3

Karthik / Marissa — internal notes and timeline estimates below.

Summary of workstreams: 
- Provisioning (infra team): 3 weeks to provision two isolated EU clusters with network segmentation and KMS tie-ins (assuming access and routing approved).
- Data plane capacity increase (on-prem enclave): configurational change + 2-stage validation; staging -> canary -> production (10 days).
- Security review (SOC docs + audit trail): 5 business days for evidence collection; Customer must provide IP allowlist and ASN for peering.
- Cutover window: we recommend two 4-hour windows (staging sync + final switch).

Risks & constraints:
- If procurement delays signatures beyond 2027-05-10 we may slip initial provision by 2–3 weeks due to capacity planning.
- SLA exceptions: during final sync we recommend a temporary latency SLO relaxation for heavy batch jobs; operationally we'll enable cross-region fallbacks.

Action items: 
- Marissa: create SOW addendum and commercial delta options (12/24mo) by EOD Wednesday (2027-04-21).
- Karthik: review SOW, callout any architectural caveats.
- Marissa / Priyom: prepare an approvals checklist for Contracts (include DocuSign link and required security artifacts).

Priyom
Senior Technical Program Manager — Redwood Inference
From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@medicorps.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Medicorps Contracts <contracts@medicorps.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal: Private deployment capacity increase & isolation for Q3

Thanks — this looks good and aligned with our timeline. A couple quick clarifications: 
- We can sign a 12-month addendum initially; if pricing is favorable we'll move to 24 months at renewal.
- Preferred blackout windows: Jul 2 00:00–04:00 UTC or Jul 8 02:00–06:00 UTC (either works).
- I'll ask Contracts to be ready to review the amendment once you share the DocuSign link.

Please send the SOW and the DocuSign link; we'll prioritize internal approvals. If you can also include a brief runbook excerpt in the amendment that lists the two key rollback steps, that'll help speed security's OK.

Alex

Attachment: signed-ma-amendment.pdf (stub; pending signature)
